= Content Migration Guide: Importing External Knowledge =

== Executive Summary

This guide provides procedures for migrating content from external sources into BITwiki while maintaining epistemic integrity, proper attribution, and SMW compatibility.

'''Supported Sources:'''
* Wikipedia (CC BY-SA compatible)
* Grokpedia (check license)
* Academic databases (check access)
* Other wikis (license-dependent)
* Original research (with epistemic marking)

----
== 1. Pre-Migration Assessment

=== 1.1 License Compatibility

| Source | License | Compatible | Notes |
|--------|---------|------------|-------|
| Wikipedia | CC BY-SA 4.0 | ✅ Yes | Attribution required |
| Grokpedia | Varies | ⚠️ Check | Verify per article |
| H+pedia | CC BY-SA 3.0 | ✅ Yes | Attribution required |
| RationalWiki | CC BY-SA 3.0 | ✅ Yes | Attribution required |
| Academic papers | Varies | ⚠️ Check | Usually not compatible |
| Personal notes | N/A | ✅ Yes | Original content |

'''License Requirements:'''
* CC BY-SA: Attribution + ShareAlike
* CC BY: Attribution only
* Public Domain: No restrictions
* Proprietary: Not compatible

=== 1.2 Content Quality Assessment

'''Before Migration:'''
* [ ] Verify source reliability
* [ ] Check epistemic status at source
* [ ] Assess confidence level
* [ ] Identify primary sources
* [ ] Note any disputes or controversies

'''Red Flags:'''
* Unsourced claims
* Edit wars at source
* Outdated information
* Biased language
* Circular references

=== 1.3 Epistemic Mapping

'''Map Source Status to BITwiki:'''

| Source Status | BITwiki Status | Confidence |
|---------------|----------------|------------|
| Featured Article | Established | 0.85-0.95 |
| Good Article | Established | 0.75-0.85 |
| B-Class | Emerging | 0.60-0.75 |
| C-Class | Emerging | 0.50-0.65 |
| Start/Stub | Hypothetical | 0.30-0.50 |
| Disputed | Contested | Variable |

----
== 2. Migration Workflows

=== 2.1 Wikipedia Migration

'''Step 1: Export from Wikipedia'''
```bash
# Use Special:Export
# Or API
https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&titles=Page_Title&export=1
```

'''Step 2: Transform Content'''
```python
# Convert Wikipedia markup to BITwiki format
# Add YAML frontmatter
# Insert epistemic markers
# Update categories
```

'''Step 3: Epistemic Marking'''
```mediawiki
---
title: "Page Title"
description: "Migrated from Wikipedia"
type: concept
author: "Wikipedia Contributors"
created: "2026-02-13"
version: "1.0.0"
ontology:
 entity_type: concept
 domain: [domain]
epistemic_status: Emerging
confidence: Established
workflow:
 state: Active
sources:
 - "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Page_Title"
license: "CC-BY-SA-4.0"
---

{{Documentation}}

[[Category:Migrated Content]]
[[Category:Wikipedia Source]]

{{Epistemic_Marker
|confidence=Medium
|evidence=Wikipedia (B-Class)
|status=Under review
}}

{{Migrated_From
|source=Wikipedia
|url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Page_Title
|date=2026-02-13
|license=CC-BY-SA-4.0
}}

[Original Wikipedia content]

== References ==
<references />

== External Links ==
* [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Page_Title Wikipedia article]


```

'''Step 4: Import to BITwiki'''
```bash
php maintenance/importTextFile.php \
  --title "Page_Title" \
  --overwrite \
  migrated_content.wiki
```

=== 2.2 Grokpedia Migration

'''Step 1: Verify License'''
* Check Grokpedia terms of service
* Verify per-article license
* Document license in migration

'''Step 2: Extract Content'''
```bash
# Manual extraction or API if available
# Grokpedia may not have export API
```

'''Step 3: Transform and Mark'''
```mediawiki
{{Migrated_From
|source=Grokpedia
|url=https://grokipedia.com/article/...
|date=2026-02-13
|license=[Check and document]
}}

{{Epistemic_Marker
|confidence=Medium
|evidence=AI-synthesized
|status=Under review
}}
```

'''Note:''' Grokpedia content may require additional verification due to AI generation.

=== 2.3 Academic Database Migration

'''Step 1: Check Access Rights'''
* Verify institutional access
* Check publisher permissions
* Document fair use rationale

'''Step 2: Extract and Summarize'''
* Do not copy full text (copyright)
* Create original summary
* Cite with DOI
* Link to source

'''Step 3: Create BITwiki Article'''
```mediawiki
---
title: "Research Summary: [Title]"
type: source
author: "[Your Name]"
created: "2026-02-13"
epistemic_status: Established
confidence: Established
sources:
 - "[DOI or citation]"
---

= Research Summary: [Title] =

{{Infobox_Source
|title=[Original Title]
|author=[Authors]
|date=[Publication Date]
|type=Journal Article
|doi=[DOI]
|tier=T2
}}

[Original summary, not copied text]

== Key Findings ==
- Finding 1
- Finding 2

== BITwiki Relevance ==
[How this relates to BITwiki concepts]

== References ==
[1] [Full citation with DOI]
```

=== 2.4 Bulk Migration

'''Using XML Import:'''
```bash
# Export from source
# Transform with script
# Import to BITwiki

php maintenance/importDump.php export.xml
```

'''Using Data Transfer Extension:'''
```bash
# Enable Extension:DataTransfer
# Use Special:ImportData
# Map fields to SMW properties
```

----
== 3. Content Transformation

=== 3.1 Markup Conversion

'''Wikipedia → BITwiki:'''

| Wikipedia | BITwiki | Notes |
|-----------|---------|-------|
| `{{Infobox ...}}` | `{{Infobox_Entity|...}}` | Convert to BITwiki infobox |
| `[[Category:...]]` | `[[Category:BITwiki ...]]` | Add BITwiki prefix |
| `{{Citation needed}}` | `{{Epistemic_Marker|...}}` | Add uncertainty marker |
| `{{Disputed}}` | `[[Has epistemic status::Contested]]` | Set status |
| `{{Primary source}}` | `{{Evidence_Tier|T1}}` | Mark evidence tier |

'''Template Conversion:'''
```python
def convert_wikipedia_to_bitwiki(text):
    # Convert infoboxes
    text = re.sub(r'\{\{Infobox (\w+)', r'{{Infobox_Entity', text)
    
    # Convert categories
    text = re.sub(r'\[\[Category:(\w+)', r'[[Category:BITwiki \1', text)
    
    # Add epistemic markers
    text = add_epistemic_markers(text)
    
    # Add YAML frontmatter
    text = add_yaml_frontmatter(text)
    
    return text
```

=== 3.2 Epistemic Enhancement

'''Add Missing Markers:'''
* Confidence scores
* Evidence tiers
* Falsification conditions
* Uncertainty markers

'''Example:'''
```mediawiki
Original: "Systems science is the study of systems."

Enhanced: "Systems science is the study of systems.{{Citation needed|confidence=Medium}}"

With marker: "Systems science is the study of systems.{{Epistemic_Marker|confidence=Medium|evidence=Secondary sources|status=Under review}}"
```

=== 3.3 SMW Property Addition

'''Add Semantic Markup:'''
```mediawiki
[[Has title::Page Title]]
[[Has domain::Systems Science]]
[[Has confidence::0.75]]
[[Has epistemic status::Emerging]]
[[Was derived from::Wikipedia]]
[[Has source URL::https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Page_Title]]
```

----
== 4. Quality Assurance

=== 4.1 Post-Migration Checklist
* [ ] YAML frontmatter complete
* [ ] Epistemic markers added
* [ ] SMW properties set
* [ ] Categories assigned
* [ ] Attribution included
* [ ] License documented
* [ ] Links verified
* [ ] References formatted
* [ ] See Also section added
* [ ] External links included

=== 4.2 Validation

'''Epistemic Validation:'''
```bash
php maintenance/runEpistemicAudit.php \
  --page "Migrated_Page" \
  --output validation.json
```

'''Link Check:'''
```bash
php maintenance/checkBrokenLinks.php \
  --page "Migrated_Page"
```

'''SMW Verification:'''
```mediawiki
{{#ask: [[Migrated_Page]]
|?Has title
|?Has confidence
|?Has epistemic status
|format=table
}}
```

=== 4.3 Review Process

'''Steward Review:'''
# Submit for review
# Address feedback
# Update epistemic status
# Finalize

'''Community Review:'''
* Post on Community Portal
* Request feedback
* Incorporate suggestions
* Update confidence

----
== 5. Special Cases

=== 5.1 Disputed Content

'''Migration Strategy:'''
* Preserve multiple viewpoints
* Mark as Contested
* Include dispute summary
* Link to discussion

'''Template:'''
```mediawiki
{{Contested_Content
|issue=Description of dispute
|viewpoints=Viewpoint 1; Viewpoint 2
|status=Ongoing
}}
```

=== 5.2 Outdated Content

'''Migration Strategy:'''
* Mark as Historical
* Add update date
* Link to current version
* Note changes

'''Template:'''
```mediawiki
{{Historical_Content
|as_of=2025-01-01
|current_version=Link to updated content
|changes=Summary of changes
}}
```

=== 5.3 Non-English Sources

'''Migration Strategy:'''
* Translate to English
* Preserve original title
* Link to original
* Note translation

'''Template:'''
```mediawiki
{{Translated_From
|original_title=[Original Title]
|language=[Language]
|translator=[Your Name]
|source_url=[URL]
}}
```

----
== 6. Automation

=== 6.1 Migration Scripts

'''Python Migration Tool:'''
```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""BITwiki Migration Tool"""

import requests
import re
import yaml

class BITwikiMigrator:
    def __init__(self, source, target):
        self.source = source
        self.target = target
    
    def fetch_wikipedia(self, title):
        """Fetch article from Wikipedia"""
        url = f"https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php"
        params = {
            'action': 'query',
            'titles': title,
            'prop': 'revisions',
            'rvslots': 'main',
            'rvprop': 'content',
            'format': 'json'
        }
        response = requests.get(url, params=params)
        return response.json()
    
    def transform_content(self, content, source_info):
        """Transform to BITwiki format"""
        # Add YAML frontmatter
        frontmatter = {
            'title': source_info['title'],
            'description': f"Migrated from {source_info['source']}",
            'type': 'concept',
            'author': source_info['author'],
            'created': datetime.now().isoformat(),
            'epistemic_status': 'Emerging',
            'confidence': 0.70,
            'sources': [source_info['url']],
            'license': source_info['license']
        }
        
        yaml_text = yaml.dump(frontmatter, default_flow_style=False)
        
        # Convert markup
        content = self.convert_markup(content)
        
        # Add epistemic marker
        marker = "{{Epistemic_Marker|confidence=Medium|evidence=Secondary sources|status=Under review}}"
        
        return f"---\n{yaml_text}---\n\n{marker}\n\n{content}"
    
    def convert_markup(self, content):
        """Convert source markup to BITwiki"""
        # Convert infoboxes
        content = re.sub(r'\{\{Infobox', '{{Infobox_Entity', content)
        
        # Convert categories
        content = re.sub(r'\[\[Category:', '[[Category:BITwiki ', content)
        
        return content
    
    def upload_to_bitwiki(self, title, content):
        """Upload to BITwiki"""
        # Use MediaWiki API
        pass

# Usage
migrator = BITwikiMigrator('wikipedia', 'bitwiki')
content = migrator.fetch_wikipedia('Systems_science')
transformed = migrator.transform_content(content, {
    'title': 'Systems Science',
    'source': 'Wikipedia',
    'author': 'Wikipedia Contributors',
    'url': 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Systems_science',
    'license': 'CC-BY-SA-4.0'
})
```

=== 6.2 Batch Processing

'''Batch Migration Script:'''
```bash
#!/bin/bash
# migrate_batch.sh

PAGES="Systems_science Cybernetics Recursion"

for page in $PAGES; do
    echo "Migrating: $page"
    python migrate.py --source wikipedia --title "$page"
done
```

----
== 7. Troubleshooting

=== 7.1 Common Issues

'''Import Fails:'''
* Check file encoding (must be UTF-8)
* Verify XML format
* Check for illegal characters
* Review import limits

'''SMW Properties Not Set:'''
* Verify Property: pages exist
* Check property syntax
* Rebuild semantic data

'''Links Broken:'''
* Update internal links
* Check external link format
* Verify page names

=== 7.2 Getting Help

'''Resources:'''
* [[BITwiki_Migration_Guide|This Guide]]
* [[BITwiki_User_Guide|User Guide]]
* [[Special:Import|Import Page]]
* [[BITwiki_Community_Portal|Community Portal]]

----
== Conclusion

Content migration requires careful attention to epistemic integrity, licensing, and quality. By following these procedures, you ensure BITwiki maintains its standards while expanding its knowledge base.

'''Key Principles:'''
* Verify licenses before migration
* Mark epistemic status honestly
* Attribute sources properly
* Enhance with SMW properties
* Validate after migration

'''Next Steps:'''
# Assess content for migration
# Verify licenses
# Transform and enhance
# Import and validate
# Request review

= Content Migration Guide: Importing External Knowledge =

== Executive Summary

This guide provides procedures for migrating content from external sources into BITwiki while maintaining epistemic integrity, proper attribution, and SMW compatibility.

'''Supported Sources:'''
* Wikipedia (CC BY-SA compatible)
* Grokpedia (check license)
* Academic databases (check access)
* Other wikis (license-dependent)
* Original research (with epistemic marking)

----
== 1. Pre-Migration Assessment

=== 1.1 License Compatibility

| Source | License | Compatible | Notes |
|--------|---------|------------|-------|
| Wikipedia | CC BY-SA 4.0 | ✅ Yes | Attribution required |
| Grokpedia | Varies | ⚠️ Check | Verify per article |
| H+pedia | CC BY-SA 3.0 | ✅ Yes | Attribution required |
| RationalWiki | CC BY-SA 3.0 | ✅ Yes | Attribution required |
| Academic papers | Varies | ⚠️ Check | Usually not compatible |
| Personal notes | N/A | ✅ Yes | Original content |

'''License Requirements:'''
* CC BY-SA: Attribution + ShareAlike
* CC BY: Attribution only
* Public Domain: No restrictions
* Proprietary: Not compatible

=== 1.2 Content Quality Assessment

'''Before Migration:'''
* [ ] Verify source reliability
* [ ] Check epistemic status at source
* [ ] Assess confidence level
* [ ] Identify primary sources
* [ ] Note any disputes or controversies

'''Red Flags:'''
* Unsourced claims
* Edit wars at source
* Outdated information
* Biased language
* Circular references

=== 1.3 Epistemic Mapping

'''Map Source Status to BITwiki:'''

| Source Status | BITwiki Status | Confidence |
|---------------|----------------|------------|
| Featured Article | Established | 0.85-0.95 |
| Good Article | Established | 0.75-0.85 |
| B-Class | Emerging | 0.60-0.75 |
| C-Class | Emerging | 0.50-0.65 |
| Start/Stub | Hypothetical | 0.30-0.50 |
| Disputed | Contested | Variable |

== 3. Content Transformation

=== 3.1 Markup Conversion

'''Wikipedia → BITwiki:'''

| Wikipedia | BITwiki | Notes |
|-----------|---------|-------|
| `{{Infobox ...}}` | `{{Infobox_Entity|...}}` | Convert to BITwiki infobox |
| `[[Category:...]]` | `[[Category:BITwiki ...]]` | Add BITwiki prefix |
| `{{Citation needed}}` | `{{Epistemic_Marker|...}}` | Add uncertainty marker |
| `{{Disputed}}` | `[[Has epistemic status::Contested]]` | Set status |
| `{{Primary source}}` | `{{Evidence_Tier|T1}}` | Mark evidence tier |

'''Template Conversion:'''
```python
def convert_wikipedia_to_bitwiki(text):
    # Convert infoboxes
    text = re.sub(r'\{\{Infobox (\w+)', r'{{Infobox_Entity', text)
    
    # Convert categories
    text = re.sub(r'\[\[Category:(\w+)', r'[[Category:BITwiki \1', text)
    
    # Add epistemic markers
    text = add_epistemic_markers(text)
    
    # Add YAML frontmatter
    text = add_yaml_frontmatter(text)
    
    return text
```

=== 3.2 Epistemic Enhancement

'''Add Missing Markers:'''
* Confidence scores
* Evidence tiers
* Falsification conditions
* Uncertainty markers

'''Example:'''

Enhanced: "Systems science is the study of systems.{{Citation needed|confidence=Medium}}"

With marker: "Systems science is the study of systems.{{Epistemic_Marker|confidence=Medium|evidence=Secondary sources|status=Under review}}"
```
